tools.name: list_games
tools.description: Search the public game catalog and inspect playable or coming-soon status. No account, private games, or credentials are accessed.

tools.name: get_rankings
tools.description: Read public game and player rankings. Practice scores are client-reported and scoring scales differ across games. No account details or balances are returned.

tools.name: get_documentation
tools.description: Read published product, authentication, pricing, games, or API documentation. Explains current capabilities and limitations without accessing an account.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "list_games" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Search the public game catalog and inspect playable or coming-soon status. No account, private games, or credentials are accessed.
